rows.description: A young couple divides cooking, care and money by ability and time rather than by gender. Fairness needs regular talk, and elders may need gentle patience as they adjust.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A young woman is stared at or followed on a road and learns to plan her routes. The fault lies with the harasser; bystanders can speak up, and she can report and seek help without being blamed.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.description: A young man hears a friend joke about women drivers or rape and decides whether to laugh or object. Speaking up calmly in the moment shifts what a group will accept.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A child notices which children sit apart, whose parents work in the house and whose name gets teased. Children see difference early; how adults explain it shapes fairness or prejudice.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A child repeats a caste or class insult heard at home without grasping its weight. Calm correction that names the hurt and explains that people are equal works better than shouting.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A teenager is mocked for surname, dress or family work, or denied a seat or invitation. The wound is real and lasting; being believed and supported by teachers and peers is vital.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A teenager from a comfortable background does not notice that their ease comes with advantages others do not have. Learning to see it need not bring guilt, only greater fairness and thankfulness.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 18–22, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A young adult hears heated arguments over quotas and merit, and feels drawn to angry slogans. Listening to lived experience and to data, and staying respectful, is wiser than picking a tribe.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.subtype: Hidden discrimination in work and housing [Receiver]
rows.description: A young adult finds that a landlord or a hiring panel asks about surname, food or region before deciding. Naming this as discrimination, documenting it and seeking allies or legal help is a mature response.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 23–26

rows.subtopic: Caste and class awareness, discrimination recognition and fair conduct
rows.description: A young adult pays on time, offers dignity, uses the same cups and greets the helper as a person, not a servant. Small daily conduct is where class prejudice either continues or ends.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 7–12, 13–17, 18–22
